title: Economical lattice coverings by determined segments
summary: For fixed $d\geq 2$, let $τ_d(n)$ be the minimum size of a set $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n\}^d$ such that the affine lines determined by pairs of distinct points of $S$ cover the grid. Let $σ_d(n)$ be the analogous minimum when every grid point must lie on the closed segment joining two distinct points of $S$. A celebrated result of Alon [GAFA, 1991] proved that $τ_d(n)$ is of order between $Ω_d(n^{α_d})$ and $O_d(n^{α_d}\log n)$, where $α_d=\frac{d(d-1)}{2d-1}$, and asked whether the logarithm term is necessary.
